title: swm-20210427
主要内容: Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc. filed a Form 8-K with the SEC on April 27, 2021, to report a current event related to regulatory compliance. The filing includes the company's details, such as its incorporation in Delaware and its IRS Employer Identification Number. It does not contain specific financial results or operational updates but is a standard regulatory filing. On April 22, 2021, the company held its 2021 Annual Meeting. Proposal One involved the election of directors, with Kimberly E. Ritrievi and John Rogers elected to serve until the 2024 Annual Meeting. Proposal Two was the ratification of Deloitte & Touche LLP as the independent registered public accounting firm for 2021. Proposal Three was a non-binding advisory vote on executive compensation.
